findings: learner.overview: Explain the distinct early numeral account and competing proposals: Shang 亖 is described as directly representing four and coexisting with forms written 四; separately, some 四 forms are interpreted as counting rods. Distinguish these from the proposed breath-related graph for 呬, later borrowed for four on a proposed sound similarity, and the separate proposal that 四 was the original graph for 泗 (“nasal discharge”), later borrowed for four, which is explicitly said to lack textual attestation. Keep the breath referent’s ancient name unresolved. Cite X-e6d62080b1a5fc5178a4, X-7b17032f87fb77433387, X-2723cf5f9190c41c2cfe, and X-4b62255296f832195814.
